native.ds_version: Actual negotiated revision; latest public revision does not upgrade installed endpoints.
native.ds_phy: Actual D-PHY classic DDR clock path or separately registered C-PHY/A-PHY/advanced D-PHY codec.
native.ds_device: Actual implementation, not an automotive template or inherited CSI transmitter.
native.ds_direction: Selected endpoint direction; bridge output is a separate canonical LVDS path.
native.ds_mode: Actual display operation and panel compatibility; no universal burst/command default.
native.ds_clock_mode: Actual clock lane continuity; continuous required when TI LVDS clock derives from DSI.
native.ds_packet: Actual classic short vs long packet; DSI long type0x09/0x0A are not CSI short packets.
native.ds_header: Actual classic four-byte header/DI or explicitly registered advanced codec.
native.ds_packet_direction: Actual processor-to-peripheral vs peripheral-to-processor data-type namespace.
native.ds_format: Actual wire pixel packing; RGB666 loose uses24 serialized bits rather than18.
native.ds_command: Actual command family; DCS byte count includes command opcode.
native.ds_interface: Actual Lattice pixel conversion or complete packet passthrough.
native.ds_lvds_clock_source: Actual TI output clock source, distinct control bus and pixel stream.
native.ds_lvds_format: Actual TI 18bpp or24bpp FlatLink pin mapping, not wire RGB666 packing.
native.ds_revision: Actual device/IP/PHY/DSI/DCS revisions and supported negotiated features.
native.ds_binding_source: Actual host/display lane/clock/VC ownership and canonical interfaces.
native.ds_device_source: Actual package, FPGA family/speed grade and implemented options.
native.ds_panel_source: Actual panel timing, active geometry, blanking, mode, power sequence and refresh requirements.
native.ds_physical_source: Actual supply/temperature/termination/channel eye and calibration qualification.
native.ds_rate_source: Actual lane/trio rate and encoding; not aggregate pixel clock or guessed2.5G.
native.ds_codec_source: Actual header/ECC/CRC and pixel/command packing and compression/PPS mapping.
native.ds_schedule_source: Actual packets per line/burst, LP/HS/BTA/TE/blanking, stalls and underrun bounds.
native.ds_capacity_source: Actual serialized full path including PHY transitions and bridge buffering.
native.ds_acceptance_source: Actual functional E2E/freshness/safety/security acceptance, separate from CRC.
native.ds_registered_source: Actual registered revision/PHY/feature/codec implementation, not compatibility label.
native.ds_feature_source: Actual optional VRR/Hybrid/compression/TE/readback support at both endpoints.
native.ds_measurement_source: Actual fixture, rate, UI, load, operating envelope and measured bounds.
native.ds_control_network_id: Actual separate canonical I2C CSR interface, not display data bitrate.
native.ds_control_source: Actual I2C address-pin state and transaction timing evidence.
native.ds_lvds_network_id: Actual separately bound canonical FlatLink output and panel interface.
native.ds_pll_source: Actual clock source/range/divider/multiplier programming before PLL enable.
native.ds_ppi_source: Actual generated Lattice PPI8/16 and controller configuration; not editable default.
native.ds_buffer_source: Actual Lattice FIFO width/depth, backpressure and worst-case overflow evidence.
native.ds_timing_source: Actual source transition/idle timing relative to calibrated clocks and selected PHY.
native.ds_error_acceptance_source: Actual EoTP-disabled or known ECC-reporting exception acceptance evidence.
native.ds_dcs_version: Actual DCS command set revision and endpoint-supported commands, separate from DSI revision.
native.ds_lanes: Actual D-PHY data lane count or registered PHY topology; TI1/2/3/4 versus Lattice1/2/4.
native.ds_clock_lanes: Actual classic forwarded clock pair count, distinct data lanes.
native.ds_lane_bitrate_bps: Actual classic DDR serialized bitrate per data lane; qualified device minimum is conditional.
native.ds_clock_hz: Actual classic D-PHY forwarded clock=lane bitrate/2, not pixel clock.
native.ds_aggregate_bps: Coding-only data lane sum, not sustained useful pixel capacity.
native.ds_vc: Actual basic DSI virtual channel0..3; TI83 does not support virtual-channel operation.
native.ds_data_type: Actual6bit direction-qualified DSI opcode; numeric CSI short/long split does not apply.
native.ds_data_id: Basic packet DI=64*VC+DT, not validated reserved opcode support by itself.
native.ds_word_count: Actual long payload octets0..65535, not pixels or full packet bytes.
native.ds_header_bytes: Actual classic four-byte header including ECC; advanced codec needs own source.
native.ds_footer_bytes: Actual classic long CRC two bytes; none for short packet.
native.ds_packet_bytes: Actual classic SHORT4 vs LONG WC+6, excluding PHY burst framing.
native.ds_command_bytes: Actual generic parameters or DCS opcode-plus-parameters count; short data lives inside header.
native.ds_max_return_bytes: Actual programmed maximum returned long payload, not confirmed response length.
native.ds_line_pixels: Actual pixel count per pixel-stream packet; complete packing groups required.
native.ds_pixel_bits: Actual useful per-pixel component bits16/18/24 versus serialized bits.
native.ds_wire_pixel_bits: Actual serialized packing depth; RGB666_LOOSE24 distinct useful18.
native.ds_packing_remainder: Actual pixel/group modulo; packedRGB666 four pixels/nine bytes, not ceil truncation.
native.ds_active_pixels: Actual TI12bit active horizontal line length, not test-only vertical geometry.
native.ds_lvds_clock_hz: Actual FlatLink pixel clock25..154MHz for TI83, not D-PHY lane bitrate.
native.ds_reference_clock_hz: Actual TI25..154MHz or LatticeSoft60M/Hard60..200M clock source.
native.ds_clock_divider_code: Actual TI DSI divider register0..24 means divisor1..25; zero required for REFCLK.
native.ds_clock_multiplier_code: Actual TI REFCLK register0..3 means multiplier1..4; zero required for DSI source.
native.ds_dsi_clock_range_code: Actual TI five-MHz bucket8..100;100 represents exact500MHz, reset0 is reserved.
native.ds_lvds_clock_range_code: Actual TI six output-clock buckets0..5;6/7 reserved.
native.ds_control_rate_bps: Actual TI separate I2C<=400kbit/s, no automatic confirmed address.
native.ds_control_address: Actual TI7bit address44/45 from ADDR pin, not8bit58/5Awrite bytes.
native.ds_sync_delay_pixels: Actual TI programmed sync delay>=32, plus roughly10 pipeline pixel clocks.
native.ds_hsync_pixels: Actual TI10bit HS width, panel-specific not default zero.
native.ds_vsync_lines: Actual TI10bit VS width, panel-specific not default zero.
native.ds_hback_pixels: Actual TI8bit H-back-porch, not generic missing Ethernet timing.
native.ds_test_vlines: Actual TI12bit test-pattern-only vertical display size, not live stream counter.
native.ds_equalization_db: Actual TI data equalization0/1/2dB; CSRcode2 reserved, value2 mapscode3.
native.ds_clock_equalization_db: Actual TI clock equalization0/1/2dB with own register.
native.ds_lvds_term_ohm: Actual TI internal near-end100/200ohm, distinct external differential90..132ohm load.
native.ds_lvds_load_ohm: Actual TI recommended differential external load90..132ohm.
native.ds_swing_code: Actual TI differential swing code0..3; data/clock voltage rows differ.
native.ds_data_vod_mv: Measured TI output data differential amplitude with actual termination/swing.
native.ds_clock_vod_mv: Measured TI clock differential amplitude;100ohm code2 row typo requires qualified source.
native.ds_common_adjust_code: Actual TI LVDS common-mode adjustment00/01/10/11, not physical Vcc.
native.ds_vcc_v: Actual TI operating supply1.65..1.95V, not absolute maximum2.175V.
native.ds_temperature_c: Actual non-Q1 TI83 operating free-air temperature-40..85C.
native.ds_case_temperature_c: Actual TI case temperature<=92.2C under selected thermal qualification.
native.ds_supply_noise_v: Actual TI supply noise<=.05V at frequency>1MHz.
native.ds_hs_diff_mv: Actual TI DSI RX differential70..270mV, not CSI transmitter140..270.
native.ds_rx_diff_ohm: Actual TI DSI differential input80..125ohm, not individual TX output impedance.
native.ds_setup_ui: Measured TI receiver data setup>=.15UI; UI=half HS clock period.
native.ds_ref_jitter_ps: Actual TI REFCLK phase peak-to-peak jitter<=50ps.
native.ds_ssc_depth_percent: Actual enabled TI center-spread input depth.5..2percent, not default clock drift.
native.ds_reset_low_ms: Actual TI EN held low>=10ms while Vcc high.
native.ds_enable_wait_ms: Actual TI recommended>=10ms after EN high before CSR initialization.
native.ds_pll_wait_ms: Actual TI recommended>=10ms after enable; status polling bound>=3ms distinct.
native.ds_soft_reset_wait_ms: Actual TI recommended>=10ms after SOFT_RESET before streaming.
native.ds_stream_wait_ms: Actual TI recommended>=5ms before optional readback/error checking.
native.ds_error_clear_wait_ms: Actual TI recommended>=1ms after optional W1C before error read.
native.ds_phy_width_bits: Actual Lattice generated8Soft/8or16Hard PPI, not pixels.
native.ds_byte_clock_hz: Actual Lattice lane bit rate/PPIwidth, not universal lane/8.
native.ds_controller_bits: Actual Lattice DSI RX32/64;64 requires Hard/16PPI/4lanes.
native.ds_axis_width_bits: Actual Lattice UVSI allocation*PPC or MBSI controller width.
native.ds_free_clock_hz: Actual Lattice RX free-running clock>=60MHz and>=PPI clock.
native.ds_buffer_depth: Actual configured receive FIFO entries; stalls>=depth can overflow.
native.ds_stall_cycles: Actual worst-case downstream not-ready duration, not assumed zero.
native.ds_reconfiguration_wait_ms: Actual Lattice RX>=2ms after PHY_CONFIG before CONFIG_REGready.
native.ds_hs_prepare_ns: Actual source LP00 prepare with vendor-qualified extra synchronization budget.
native.ds_hs_zero_ns: Actual source HS0 duration; Soft sum>=145+10UI+8reference periods.
native.ds_ui_ns: Actual instantaneous source UI, not automatically ideal1/rate.
native.ds_idle_ns: Actual selected Lattice HSexit-to-LPX or noncontinuousCLKpost-to-LPX interval.
native.ds_mipi_idle_min_ns: Actual normative source-qualified global idle requirement, no guessed value.
native.ds_readback: Actual reverse/read operation; unsupported on TI83.

native.ds_crc_check: Actual receiver CRC checking; not safety or authentication proof.

native.ds_vrr: Actual optional DSI2.2 variable-refresh operation, not all older endpoints.
native.ds_compression: Actual compression and negotiated PPS codec, not uncompressed rate ratio.

scope: Every declared native parameter reviewed for meaning, applicability, type/unit/bounds/dependencies, revision/source, proposal and actual evidence; every retained NIS scenario field is application policy. No2.5G global default or inherited CAN queue/retry/priority default.

DSI1.3.2 vs DSI-2 v2.2 and DCS2.1 public primary summaries checked2026-10-02. DSI legacy D-PHY differs registered DSI-2 C-PHY/A-PHY/advancedD-PHY paths. Hybrid/VRR/RGB48 require revision2.2/endpoints; actual DCS revision and compression feature source remain separate. Member norms/CTS not obtained or certified.

Direction-qualified classic DSI short/long opcode lists from pinned Linuxv6.12 differ CSI numeric ranges:0x09long and0x37short. Basic DI0..3VC/6bitDT,4byte short vsWC+6long. Kernel helper size does not include full physical CRC and has ECCgenerationTODO; no claim of executable NIS full codec.

Generic write0/1/2 parameters and DCS opcode-plus-parameters1/2 choose short; longer command uses own long datatype/WC. Generic read max2parameters and DCSread1 require actual reverse capability. SET_MAX_RETURN sets returned long bound rather than measured response.

RGB56516, packedRGB666 four pixels/nine octets, looseRGB666 useful18/wire24, RGB88824 have separate exact pixel/WC/group/DI checks. No truncating partial groups or applying camera RAWpacking to display packets.

TI83 DSI1.02/D-PHY1.00 input80..1000Mbit/s and1/2/3/4lanes distinct LatticeRX minima. No virtual-channel/reverse/BTA/command mode support. I2C7bit44/45 fromADDRpin distinct8bit58/5Aaddress-cycle bytes; separate canonical control path and<=400kclock. No guessed installed address.

TI DSI40..500MHz clock uses own5MHz bucket8..100 and exact500MHzendpoint. LVDS25..154MHz output depends on actual continuousDSIclock/divisor1..25 or25..154MREFCLK/multiplier1..4 and six range buckets. Wrong source register, reserved codes and noncontinuous DSI-source clock rejected. Required control and bridge output bindings stay separate.

TI power/temperature/receiver electrical/setup/hold/REFCLK jitter/duty/edge limits use nonQ1 source. LVDS external90..132ohm load differs internal100/200near-end termination; data versus clock swing tables separated. Duplicated100ohm clockcode01 row requires actual manufacturer clarification, not assumed correction.

TI syncdelay>=32 plus additional pipeline differs panel-selected geometry/porches and test-only vertical/front-porch registers. Test pattern disables DSI reception and proves output path only. Power/reset/PLL/ULPS sequence and recommended minimum waits source-qualified; no example200nF or resolution/FPS as universal installed default.

Lattice IP4.2.0 DSI-2 RX only, no CSI TX inheritance. GeneratedSoft8/Hard8or16 PPI determines byteclock and32/64controller. DSI minimum long WC14/34 differs CSI6/10. RXFIFO depth/stalls, free/CSRclock, dynamic AXI2ms wait, extra Softprepare/zero and PHYidle clocks checked. EoTP-disabled MPPT and known two-bit ECCreporting exception need actual acceptance evidence; no full safety certificate.

816 isolated SQL tests passed, including199 DSI cases and nine shared consumer suites. Confirmed330k controlclock/7bit45/RGB666packed2430byteWC/640Mlane survive rejected invalid packing edit. Complete cumulative native regression and release gate remain required before delivery.
